name: Cognitive flexibility
description: The broad range of abilities that enable individuals to adapt to, and act effectively in, new or unexpected situations, to bring problem-solving abilities to bear and to find creative solutions.

name: Communication
description: The ability to convey both verbal and written information clearly between individuals and groups and to adapt formats and contents to different audiences and purposes.

name: Digital competence
description: The ability to use digital technologies critically and responsibly for learning and work. This could range from data visualisation and basic programming skills to data engineering, understanding and writing algorithms, and analysing large data sets.

name: Global intercultural competence
description: This encompasses foreign language skills, the knowledge required to understand how global society functions, the ability to interact effectively and appropriately with people from different cultural backgrounds, and also to collaborate with them to find solutions to global problems.

name: Problem solving
description: The ability to identify and define problems, generate solutions, evaluate the options and to implement the chosen solution.

name: Self-management
description: The ability to organise and carry out activities without direct supervision, to be able to take responsibility, to set priorities independently and to act strategically and ethically.

name: Teamworking
description: The interrelated abilities that help individuals cooperate effectively in group settings, including emotional intelligence, communication and negotiation skills.

name: Technical competence
description: This could include specialised and sectoral expertise (i.e. knowledge and methodologies required in a specific profession), as well as the practical ability to use and handle technical equipment.
